opening.argument: The speaker promotes an investment app through unusually easy wealth claims, including 2.5% interest and a plan to earn 100,000 rupees in three days without tax. Viewers are instructed to register with personal details, bind a bank account, recharge 1,000 rupees through a payment gateway, submit the transaction reference, and expect the deposited amount plus earnings to become withdrawable after three days. This is an active, endorsed solicitation: the speaker directs interested viewers to Telegram and urges participation, rather than offering a warning or neutral demonstration. The promised timeline and withdrawal outcome make the appeal especially direct: “After 3 days you will get the total amount And you can withdrew all money.”
